{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
valid_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
valid_data = valid_data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Compute number of patients and number of original duplicates
num_patients_final = len(valid_data)
num_duplicate_rows = len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()

# Print all required values
print("Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL):")
print(mean_baseline)
print("Number of patients in the final dataset:")
print(num_patients_final)
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries in original data:")
print(num_duplicate_rows)"}
